commands: set -euo pipefail; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; $ADB devices -l; echo '--- ping from phone ---'; $ADB -s $SERIAL shell ping -c 3 -W 2 192.168.0.10 || true; echo '--- phone network ---'; $ADB -s $SERIAL shell ip route || true; $ADB -s $SERIAL shell ip addr show wlan0 || true; echo '--- available http tools ---'; $ADB -s $SERIAL shell 'command -v curl || true; command -v wget || true; toybox --list 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(wget|nc|netcat)$" || true'; echo '--- direct Shelly RPC from Mac ---'; curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 http://192.168.0.10/rpc/Shelly.GetDeviceInfo || true; echo; echo '--- direct POST RPC from Mac ---'; curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"id":1,"method":"Shelly.GetDeviceInfo"}' http://192.168.0.10/rpc || true; echo; echo '--- tcp 80 from phone ---'; $ADB -s $SERIAL shell 'toybox nc -z -w 3 192.168.0.10 80' && echo PHONE_TCP_80_OK || echo PHONE_TCP_80_FAIL; echo '--- recent app/webview network logs ---'; $ADB -s $SERIAL logcat -d -v brief | grep -Ei 'link.localclimate.app|chromium|WebView|192\.168\.0\.10|ERR_|Cleartext|NetworkSecurity' | tail -n 250 || true
